verdict.rationale: BVNK is a payments API platform with an official CLI (agent-wallet-cli), so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The webhook validator's client-side operation ('without sending sensitive data to external servers') is an adjacent privacy feature of a separate tool, not a telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.
